verdict.line: You lose if Shen's Vorpal Blade poke and Shadow Dash taunt bleed you out before level 6; you win if you hit level 6 with Fury of the Sands and your Q stacks intact.

brief.thesis: Shen's Vorpal Blade (Q, range 475) outranges your Siphoning Strike (Q, range 255), so he pokes you for free while Shadow Dash (E) threatens a taunt-gank at any moment — that's the measured 47.6% win rate over 1496 games and the lane/solo-kill edge going his way. He has no answer to stacked Q damage or Fury of the Sands once you hit level 6, so this is a lane you survive, not win, before you scale through him.

theirWindow.what: He can poke with Vorpal Blade then dash through a wave to taunt you into his jungler. Back off wave contests and hug your own minions so the dash path gets blocked.

yourWindow.when: Level 6+, Fury of the Sands (R) ready
yourWindow.what: R gives bonus health, attack range, and drains nearby max health into damage for its duration. Force the all-in here — Feint's shield doesn't outlast a sustained drain the way it outlasts a single Q poke.

start.why: Doran's Shield is the 62.3%-pick, 47.9%-winrate start in this matchup — the regen and block-on-hit directly offset Vorpal Blade's chip poke.

boots.why: 48.3% win rate and the 50.3% pick in this matchup; the extra ability haste shortens Siphoning Strike and Spirit Fire, letting you stack Q faster and shred armor more often per trade.

core.why: Highest-performing path in the data (53.2% over 267 games); the burst of damage and movement speed is what finally lets you catch Shen through Feint.
Second item on the top path; cooldown reduction feeds your Q stacking and attack speed slow helps vs his Ki Strike-empowered autos.
Closes out the top-winrate build; sustain scales with your already-high Soul Eater lifesteal for lane and extended skirmishes.

you want wave clear and a slow instead of Trinity's pure damage spike
his early Q poke is harassing you harder than expected before level 6

runes.keystoneWhy: The 55.7%-pick page for this matchup; the healing and move speed on hit directly counters Vorpal Blade's poke-and-retreat pattern and helps you reposition out of Shadow Dash lines.

summoners.why: Flash+Ghost posts the best win rate of the three common setups (48.8% over 27.3% pick); the extra mobility matters more here than Teleport since your job before 6 is dodging Shadow Dash and poke, not sidelaning.

playing.title: Farm safe under tower
playing.detail: Vorpal Blade (range 475) outranges Siphoning Strike (255), so don't contest CS in his face before level 6. Let early stacks go to free minions rather than trading health for Q procs.

playing.title: Respect Shadow Dash timing
playing.detail: Track his E cooldown (16/14/12/10/8s by rank). Once it's near max rank that window is only 8 seconds, so stay out of dash lines whenever his jungler is unaccounted for.

playing.title: Bait out Feint first
playing.detail: Shen's W absorbs incoming damage for a few seconds on a 9-5s cooldown. Throw a weak poke to force it, then commit your real trade once it's down.

playing.title: Spike at level 6
playing.detail: Fury of the Sands adds bonus health, attack range, and drains nearby max health into damage for its duration. Use this window to force all-ins he can't out-trade even behind Feint.

playing.title: Prioritize Q stacks
playing.detail: Every killing blow with Siphoning Strike permanently raises its damage. Take Q resets on minions whenever safe — this is your actual win condition against a champion who never falls behind defensively.

playing.title: Shred with Spirit Fire
playing.detail: E has a flat 12s cooldown and drops armor on anyone standing in it. Lay it before all-ins so his physical mitigation is already down when you commit Q and autos.

playing.title: Play for scaling, not lane kills
playing.detail: Solo-kill advantage sits with Shen early, so don't force 1v1s before 6. Your Trinity Force into Frozen Heart/Spirit Visage timing is where this lane actually flips in your favor.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and all win rates are pulled from measured games on the current patch via OP.GG; the ability mechanics and trade-pattern reasoning are my own analysis, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of being taunted by Shen’s Shadow Dash (E). Focus foremost on raising your [Q] and Grasp of the Undying stacks, and try to gain lane control post-level 6 with Unsealed Spellbook + Fury of the Sands [R].
